prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Practice Controlling Your Desktop Companion", "Try pressing your shortcut keys now to practice hiding, revealing, and moving your pet.", "Test Hide Shortcut", "Test Call Pet Shortcut"]
1: ["Desktop Display Verification", "Checking overlay permissions and screen compatibility to ensure your pet appears smoothly.", "Confirm & Continue"]
2: ["Official Companion Adoption Certificate", "Review your companion's official credentials before bringing them to your desktop."]
3: ["Validate Photo Quality", "Select your photo style to ensure the AI renderer generates an accurate 3D desktop companion.", "Photo Clarity Guide"]
4: ["Sign In to Restore Your Saved Desktop Pets", "Logging in reconnects your existing account so all previous pets, items, and settings load automatically."]
5: ["Companion Voice & Sound Setup", "Adjust your pet's voice pitch and sound volume before entering the desktop habitat.", "Save Audio & Continue"]
6: ["Building Your Desktop Companion", "Extracting textures, verifying screen overlay compatibility, and preparing live pet animations."]
7: ["We will notify your system tray as soon as your pet is ready to leap onto your desktop."]
8: ["Onboarding takes less than 3 minutes. Pick your companion path to begin setup."]
9: ["100% Pet Data Protection & Automatic Restoration Guaranteed"]
